So stance: favorable to advancing regulation of lobbying (i.e., supports regulation). Manifestation B: about regulation of app drivers work. Speaker expresses concern about government pushing a hasty solution, wants caution, not rush, wants to avoid bad legislation. So stance: cautious, perhaps against rapid regulation, but not necessarily against regulation per se; wants careful process. The two manifestations address different propositions (different topics). So they are not same specific proposition. Both have determinable positions (A favors advancing regulation; B favors caution/slow). Since they are different propositions, classification is INCOMPARABLE. Need to ensure not INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (both have positions). Not RELATION_UNCERTAIN because clear. So answer INCOMPARABLE. Provide reasoning.
